item.description:
## 3.10 — 3 November 2026 - Clicking an email or text in the menu bar opens it in Glance, ready to read. - Recent people are encrypted before they're shared through iCloud, with a key only your Macs hold (in iCloud Keychain). - Reminders and events added on another device, and invitations to events made earlier, are now marked as new. - Glance checks Mail every minute and updates the rest as they change, and when an event starts or ends or a reminder falls due. - ⌘Z after moving an email to the Trash puts it back, except while you're typing. - Undo puts an email back in the right account when it's in more than one. - If Glance can't check that a new text was delivered, it says so rather than reporting it sent. - A reminder that Reminders won't complete is unticked again; VoiceOver says which rows are new or overdue. - Many smaller fixes for reliability and speed.
## 3.9 — 2 November 2026 - Fixed the menu bar menu opening lower than the menu bar or with empty space around it.
## 3.8 — 2 November 2026 - The menu bar badges are bigger and darker, with larger symbols and squarer corners, so they stand out more. - The update window lists what's changed in every version since the one you have, not just the newest.
## 3.7 — 2 November 2026 - Fixed the menu bar menu sitting in empty space after its new items were read.
## 3.6 — 1 November 2026 - Glance updates itself: it checks for a new version once a day and asks before installing it. Check for Updates… is in the Glance menu, the menu bar and Settings. - The email reader's buttons, with Open in Mail, sit in one row above the sender and subject.
